  image: ubuntu:24.04
  config: rwx/base 1.2.0

# The code, uv-install, deps and reflex-export tasks are byte-identical to
# reflex-build.yml so RWX's content cache reuses its result instead of
# re-running the export; keep them in lockstep.
tasks:
  - key: code
    call: git/clone 2.2.0
    with:
      repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
      ref: ${{ init.commit-sha }}
      fetch-full-depth: true
      preserve-git-dir: true

  - key: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.11.13/install.sh -o "${script}"
      echo "48cd5aca5d5671a3b3d5f61538cc8622e4434af63319115159990d8b0dd02416  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      sh "${script}"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH

  - key: deps
    use: [code, uv-install]
    filter:
      - pyproject.toml
      - uv.lock
    run: |
      uv sync --frozen
      echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH
      echo "VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv" >> $RWX_ENV/VIRTUAL_ENV

  # Reflex's own bun download from GitHub releases returns 504 on RWX runners;
  # install a pinned bun the same way frontend.yml does so reflex finds it.
  - key: bun-install
    use: [deps]
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install -o "${script}"
      echo "04882bf41679d49d9af108657a1e5515bf04fdf2940d12c0d0b1e5d79dc53be8  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      bash "${script}" "bun-v1.4.3"
      echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH

  - key: reflex-export
    use: [code, deps, bun-install]
    run: |
      uv run reflex init
      uv run reflex export --frontend-only
    env:
      REFLEX_ENV: prod
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"

  - key: system-deps
    run: |
      sudo apt-get update
      sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends caddy unzip

  - key: build
    use: [reflex-export, system-deps]
    run: |
      sudo mkdir -p /srv
      sudo unzip -q frontend.zip -d /srv
      rm frontend.zip
      # The export bakes in http://localhost:8000; point it at the page origin
      # instead (Caddy proxies /_event and /_upload to the backend).
      f=$(grep -rl 'localhost:8000' /srv/assets | head -1)
      printf '%s\n' \
        'const o=location.origin,w=o.replace(/^http/,"ws");' \
        'var e={PING:o+"/ping",EVENT:w+"/_event",UPLOAD:o+"/_upload",AUTH_CODESPACE:o+"/auth-codespace",HEALTH:o+"/_health",ALL_ROUTES:o+"/_all_routes",TRANSPORT:"websocket",TEST_MODE:!1};export{e as t};' \
        | sudo tee "$f" > /dev/null

  - key: preview
    use: [build]
    app:
      endpoint: pr-${{ init.pull-request-number }}
      port: 3000
    run: |
      export PORT=3000 REFLEX_ENV=prod
      .venv/bin/reflex run --env prod --backend-only --backend-port 8000 &
      exec caddy run --config Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

  - key: share-link
    use: [preview]
    run: echo "$PREVIEW_URL"
    env:
      PREVIEW_URL: ${{ tasks.preview.app.url }}
Config lives in `.rwx/preview.yml`. Docs: https://www.rwx.com/docs/apps and
https://www.rwx.com/blog/preview-your-web-apps-with-rwx. Stick to the docs and
`rwx <cmd> --help`; don't guess at syntax.

## Layout

Tasks: `code` (git/clone) -> `uv-install` (checksum-pinned uv) -> `deps`
(`uv sync --frozen`) -> `reflex-export` (`reflex export --frontend-only`)
-> `system-deps` (caddy, unzip) -> `build` (unzips `frontend.zip` to
`/srv`) -> `preview` (`app:` task, port 3000, runs backend on :8000 +
Caddy via the repo Caddyfile) -> `share-link` (prints
`tasks.preview.app.url`).

`code`/`uv-install`/`deps`/`reflex-export` are byte-identical to
`reflex-build.yml` so RWX's content cache reuses its export instead of
re-running it; keep them in lockstep.

## Commands

- Validate: `rwx lint .rwx/preview.yml` (also flags outdated package versions)
- Test: `rwx run .rwx/preview.yml --init pull-request-number=0 --wait`

I made the edits for issue #58 but haven't run the two-run cache check from step 4 of the issue's plan. The only check so far is `rwx lint` on both files. It found no errors, just a warning on each file that `git/clone` 2.2.0 is outdated (2.4.0 is newest). I left that version alone because the sibling files pin 2.2.0.

`preview.yml` already had the `bun-install` task and `reflex-export` using `[code, deps, bun-install]` in the working tree. So the actual change was bringing the other files in line with it:

- **`.rwx/reflex-build.yml`:** I copied in the same `bun-install` task, with the same bun v1.4.3 sha256-pinned installer and explanatory comment. `reflex-export` now uses `[code, deps, bun-install]`.
- **`.rwx/preview.yml`:** the lockstep comment now lists `bun-install` among the byte-identical tasks.
- **`.agents/skills/rwx-reflex-preview/SKILL.md`:** the task chain and the lockstep note now include `bun-install`.

To confirm the cache reuse, run `rwx run .rwx/reflex-build.yml --wait` and then `rwx run .rwx/preview.yml --init pull-request-number=0 --wait`. The first run should miss the cache, and the second should serve `reflex-export` from cache. I haven't committed anything.

    run: |

        echo 'Invalid parameters: `github-token` and `cursor-origin-token` cannot both be set.' > "$RWX_ERRORS/conflicting-tokens"

      fi

      . "$RWX_PACKAGE_PATH/rwx-utils.sh"
      if ! rwx_os_package_manager_in apt apk; then
        echo "Unsupported operating system or package manager \`$(rwx_os_package_manager)\`" > "$(mktemp "$RWX_ERRORS/error-XXXXXX")"
        exit 1
      fi

      needed=""

      if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        needed="$needed jq"
      fi

      if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        needed="$needed curl"
      fi

      if [ -n "$needed" ]; then
        cat << EOF > "${RWX_ERRORS}/missing-packages"
      The \`git/clone\` package requires system packages that were missing:$needed

      Define a task which installs those packages, and specify it as a \`use\` dependency of the \`git/clone\` task
      EOF
        exit 1
      fi

      packages_to_install=""

      if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        packages_to_install="$packages_to_install git"
      fi

      if ! command -v ssh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        packages_to_install="$packages_to_install openssh-client"
      fi

      if [ -n "$packages_to_install" ]; then
        package_manager="$(rwx_os_package_manager)"
        case "$package_manager" in
          apt)
            rwx_maybe_sudo apt-get -y update
            rwx_maybe_sudo apt-get -y install $packages_to_install
            rwx_maybe_sudo apt-get -y clean
            ;;
          apk)
            apk_packages=$(echo "$packages_to_install" | sed 's/openssh-client/openssh/g')
            rwx_maybe_sudo apk add --no-cache $apk_packages
            ;;
        esac
      fi

      rwx_maybe_sudo install "$RWX_PACKAGE_PATH/bin/git-ssh-command" /usr/local/bin
      echo "git-ssh-command" >> "$RWX_ENV/GIT_SSH_COMMAND"
      if [ -n "$GIT_SSH_KEY" ]; then
        case "$CHECKOUT_REPOSITORY" in
          http://*|https://*)
            errorMessage=$(mktemp "$RWX_ERRORS/error-XXXXXX")

      EOF
            github_path="${CHECKOUT_REPOSITORY#https://github.com/}"
            if [ "$github_path" = "$CHECKOUT_REPOSITORY" ]; then
              github_path="${CHECKOUT_REPOSITORY#http://github.com/}"
            fi
            if [ "$github_path" != "$CHECKOUT_REPOSITORY" ]; then

                  org="${github_path%%/*}"
                  repo_part="${github_path#*/}"

                  truncate -s-1 "$errorMessage"

The test did not show what we wanted. Both runs succeeded, but `reflex-export` in `preview.yml` was not served from the `reflex-build.yml` cache.

| Task | `reflex-build.yml` run | `preview.yml` run (`--target reflex-export`) |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | executed | executed |
| `uv-install` | cache hit | cache hit |
| `deps` | cache hit | cache hit (same key `d2391bb…` in both) |
| `bun-install` | executed (key `9efaefc…`) | executed (key `1112970…`) |
| `reflex-export` | executed (key `ee73b4f…`) | executed (key `d2be714…`) |

`uv-install` and `deps` are shared between the two files, so the `deps` chain is fine. The new `bun-install` and `reflex-export` tasks, though, get different cache keys in the two files even though the task definitions are byte-identical. As a result bun is reinstalled in each pipeline, and the export isn't shared.

I haven't found the cause. Two guesses, neither tested:
- The `code` task differs: `preview.yml` hard-codes the repository URL, while `reflex-build.yml` takes it from `${{ init.repository }}`.
- The two files pass different init values, which may reach tasks that use `code` directly.

Dropping `code` from `reflex-export`'s `use` list would not help, since `deps` still needs it.

The runs are at https://cloud.rwx.com/elviskahoro/runs/01a1c0484e43706bb1934a6a41dabbae (`reflex-build.yml`) and https://cloud.rwx.com/elviskahoro/runs/01a1c0488e8b742aa8c82b013b92869c (`preview.yml`).
